style_summary: High-contrast athletic editorial posters that turn a frozen movement into a collision of grayscale body photography, extreme perspective, and a single red-orange energy accent.

environment_variables.STYLE_FIDELITY_ANCHORS: The prioritized reusable style anchors supplied by the package.
environment_variables.SOURCE_CONTENT_TO_AVOID: Source-specific identity, marks, wording, products and story elements to exclude.
environment_variables.SUBJECT: The athlete or central human subject.
environment_variables.SUBJECT_ACTION: The decisive athletic action or suspended gesture.
environment_variables.WARDROBE_STYLE: Minimal performance clothing suited to the sport.
environment_variables.PRODUCT_OR_PROP: The featured sport object, shoe, ball, board or equipment.
environment_variables.MAIN_TEXT: The short advertising headline rendered in the poster.
environment_variables.SECONDARY_TEXT: Optional small supporting copy or metadata.
environment_variables.DESIGN_DIRECTION: The case-specific compositional idea and how the action shapes the layout.
environment_variables.LOCATION: Near-white negative space isolating the athlete
environment_variables.BACKGROUND_ELEMENTS: Clean poster ground, controlled warm glow and directional heat haze
environment_variables.ACCENT_SYMBOL: Single vermilion-to-orange impact zone or energy trail

style_fidelity_anchors: [CORE] High-contrast monochrome athletic photography or photoreal cutout with deep charcoal blacks, pale gray whites and crisp anatomical form.
[CORE] A single vivid vermilion-to-orange accent is reserved for the featured object, impact zone or directional energy trail.
[CORE] Extreme wide-angle or close-perspective cropping makes one body part or sport object dominate the frame and creates visceral depth.
[CORE] Clean near-white negative space isolates the athlete and lets the action silhouette read immediately at poster scale.
[CORE] Motion is expressed by controlled warm glow, directional blur or heat haze attached to the action, never by random decorative clutter.
[CORE] Typography is compact, bold, condensed and italic, usually in red, with short legible copy integrated into the empty space.
[FLEX] Let the sport determine the dominant crop, diagonal, suspension point and interaction between the subject, prop and accent trail.
[FLEX] Vary the headline placement, scale and lockup so each case feels art-directed while retaining the same restrained poster grammar.
source_content_to_avoid: The exact Nike swoosh or any recognizable brand logo from the reference.
The exact phrase BORN FOR THE LEAP and any direct reuse of the reference wording.
The reference athlete's identity, body pose, clothing, facial features and exact shoe design.
The exact reference layout of a giant sole at top, seated jumper in the center and shoe at bottom.
A Nike campaign, brand claim or copied commercial story premise.
visual_deconstruction: A minimal editorial sports poster built from a pale neutral field, a black-and-white suspended athlete, and a red-orange focal object that behaves like a visual ignition point. The image alternates between a near-camera detail and a smaller full-body gesture, using asymmetrical balance and generous empty space. Warm light is selective and directional; the rest stays photographic, spare and slightly tactile.
composition: Use one decisive action with a clear silhouette and a designed depth hierarchy. Reserve useful negative space for the headline and supporting copy. Explore diagonal vectors, off-center crops, foreground-object dominance, split-scale relationships or a low horizon according to the case and ratio. Do not reproduce the reference's exact three-part arrangement.
typography: Use short all-caps advertising copy in a bold condensed italic sans serif, red or deep vermilion, with tight tracking and strong baseline energy. Keep wording clean and legible; use a small secondary line only when it strengthens the hierarchy.
color_palette: Near-white / #F2F1EE background, charcoal / #171717 monochrome subject, vermilion / #E21B16 headline, saturated red / #F52222 focal accent, and hot orange / #FF6A19 for restrained glow and heat.
image_treatment: Photoreal high-contrast grayscale athlete cutout with crisp edges on the main silhouette, subtle film grain at fine scale, selective soft bloom around the red-orange focal object, and directional motion softness only where it explains force or speed. Keep the background clean and matte.
design_rules: Build the hierarchy from action silhouette first, focal object or impact second, typography third.
Keep the palette mostly monochrome so the red-orange accent carries narrative weight.
Use empty space as an active compositional counterweight, not as a filler background.
Make the action-specific perspective or graphic interaction visibly different in every case.
Keep all rendered words short, high-contrast and readable at thumbnail size.
do: Use believable athletic anatomy, contact, balance and equipment geometry.
Make the warm accent explain impact, speed, elevation or contact.
Adapt the crop and headline lockup meaningfully between portrait and landscape.
avoid: Do not add brand logos, watermarks, app marks, QR codes or copied campaign identifiers.
Do not turn the image into a busy collage, generic neon sports graphic or full-color lifestyle photo.
Do not use illegible pseudo-text, excessive lens effects, random flames or decorative clutter.
prompt_template: Create a finished editorial sports advertising poster in the Chromatic Impact Athlete visual system. Apply these prioritized style anchors exactly as a coherent system: {STYLE_FIDELITY_ANCHORS}. Design a new image about {SUBJECT} performing {SUBJECT_ACTION}, wearing {WARDROBE_STYLE}, with {PRODUCT_OR_PROP}. Case direction: {DESIGN_DIRECTION}. Render a decisive, anatomically believable frozen moment with a clear silhouette, extreme perspective or scale contrast, and useful near-white negative space. Use mostly charcoal-and-pale-gray monochrome photography, reserving vivid vermilion and hot orange for the featured object, impact zone or directional energy trail. Add the short headline {MAIN_TEXT} in bold condensed italic red typography, placed wherever the composition gives it maximum hierarchy; add {SECONDARY_TEXT} only if it remains crisp and subordinate. Replace all source-specific content with this new subject and concept. Avoid: {SOURCE_CONTENT_TO_AVOID}. Preserve the specified reference-style texture, edge character and intentional softness at their described scale, intensity and locations. Avoid artifacts that are absent from the intended style; do not automatically denoise, sharpen, polish or distress the image. Generate as a 4K ultra-high-resolution raster image.
negative_prompt: No Nike swoosh, no copied brand logo, no exact reference slogan, no watermark, no QR code, no app UI, no busy background, no rainbow palette, no cartoon rendering, no plastic 3D mannequin, no illegible gibberish text, no duplicated limbs, no broken hands, no impossible equipment, no random flames, no excessive lens flare, no ornamental collage clutter.

values.SUBJECT: a female track sprinter
values.SUBJECT_ACTION: exploding out of the starting blocks, one knee driving toward the camera
values.WARDROBE_STYLE: a minimal charcoal racing singlet and shorts
values.PRODUCT_OR_PROP: a pair of streamlined racing spikes with a glowing orange sole plate
values.DESIGN_DIRECTION: Make the closest spike and forward knee form a low diagonal spear from the lower left into the open headline space; let a thin orange heat trail trace the first stride.

values.SUBJECT: a street skateboarder
values.SUBJECT_ACTION: floating above a concrete ledge in a compact grab, board tilted toward the viewer
values.WARDROBE_STYLE: a loose black technical jacket, pale pants and simple sneakers
values.PRODUCT_OR_PROP: a matte black skateboard with a vivid red underside graphic
values.DESIGN_DIRECTION: Use a near-vertical board as the dominant red-black foreground shape, with the body crossing behind it and a large quiet field above for the headline; suggest height through a warm impact haze below the board.

values.SUBJECT: a male pole vaulter
values.SUBJECT_ACTION: curving over the bar at the apex of a vault, torso suspended in a clean arc
values.PRODUCT_OR_PROP: a flexible vaulting pole glowing red-orange at its bend
values.DESIGN_DIRECTION: Let the pole create the main sweeping curve across the landscape or portrait frame, with the athlete small but sharply readable at the apex and a controlled orange halo concentrated at the bend.

values.SUBJECT: a rock climber
values.SUBJECT_ACTION: reaching one hand past the camera toward the next hold, body twisting against the wall
values.WARDROBE_STYLE: a sleeveless graphite climbing top and chalk-dusted shorts
values.PRODUCT_OR_PROP: a single red climbing hold and chalked fingertips
values.DESIGN_DIRECTION: Use the oversized reaching hand and red hold as a near-camera tension point, with the wall receding into pale negative space; place the headline along the opposite diagonal like a route marker.
